svg.title: fomo campus — hook shade, reels and tiktok overlay
svg.desc: A soft fomo ink shade over the top half, so white hook text typed in the app reads on any footage. 1080 × 1920, 9:16. Transparent: place it on its own overlay track and stretch it to fill the frame. Use: first 1–3 seconds.
svg.metadata: Text box for Reels and TikTok: 72 px left, 180 px right, 270 px top, 480 px bottom. Type hooks and captions in the app you post to (Instagram: Modern; TikTok: Classic), white and lowercase. The fomo wordmark and campus mark paths are unchanged from the masters; keep them flat. Editable Aeonik text.
